purpose: Prevent representative user-owned manuscript material from entering Literary Prose closed-loop qualification without explicit, bounded admission and frozen provenance/preservation authority.
rules: Only an explicit ADMITTED state may authorize representative real-book qualification.
The admitted source must be user-owned or explicitly authorized for this qualification.
The exact baseline source identity and digest must be frozen before any revision candidate is generated.
Qualification scope must state whether the admitted unit is passage, scene, chapter, multi-chapter sample, or full book.

Preservation obligations must bind canon, authorial intent, protected language, POV/focalization, character knowledge/integrity, explicit user constraints, required ambiguity, and any applicable historical/theological constraints.
Allowed persistence must explicitly distinguish raw manuscript text, derived metrics, candidate text, digests, evidence references, and learning records.
No repository commit may contain raw user manuscript prose merely to prove qualification.
No named-author imitation objective or universal prose score may be admitted.
Revocation is forward-only; prior qualification evidence remains historically reconstructible but cannot authorize new runs.
Admission authorizes qualification only; it does not authorize publication, deployment, canon replacement, or automatic manuscript overwrite.
